content.title: Global Index Maker MSCI Defers Decision on Dropping Crypto-Focused Companies
content.summary: MSCI will keep crypto-heavy firms in its indexes through February, deferring changes after investor feedback raised classification concerns.

content.title: MSCI drops plan to exclude digital asset treasury firms, to launch broader review
content.summary: MSCI said on Tuesday it will not proceed with a proposal to exclude ​digital asset treasury companies, or DATCOs, from ‌its indexes, but will launch a broader consultation on how non-operating ‌companies should be treated.  MSCI said it would maintain the existing treatment of companies on its preliminary list of DATCOs, defined as those whose digital asset holdings account for ⁠50% or more ‌of total assets.  MSCI said that feedback from investors showed concern that some DATCOs share characteristics with investment funds.

content.title: MSCI Keeps Strategy — For Now — But Handcuffs Bitcoin Buying
content.summary: MSCI adopted a new rule governing Strategy and other digital asset treasury firms that will keep their index weightings from growing as they issue more shares to buy bitcoin.  MSTR stock jumped in after-hours action following the announcement, though the bitcoin price edged up only slightly, reversing part of the day's loss.  While news headlines indicated a positive outcome for Strategy, MSCI signaled that exclusion of Strategy and similar firms is still firmly on the table.
